look_up_dns.description: Resolve a hostname to its IP addresses, following any aliases, or an IP address to its hostnames (reverse DNS), checking whether the hostname points back to the address as mail servers expect. No API key required.
look_up_dns.display_str_template: Look up the DNS records for {0}.
look_up_dns.name: look_up_dns

parameters.description: A hostname such as www.ripe.net (a pasted link works too), or an IP address for its hostnames.
parameters.name: name

addresses.description: For a hostname: every address it resolves to.

aliases.description: For a hostname: the aliases (CNAMEs) followed on the way.

forward_confirmed.description: For an address: true when its hostname resolves back to it, which mail servers check. Empty for a hostname.

forward_records.description: Every forward record seen (A, AAAA and CNAME).

points_to.description: The addresses or names it points to.

hostnames.description: For an address: its hostnames (PTR records).

notes.description: RIPEstat's own notes about the answer, such as an address it widened to its routed prefix or a time it moved to the nearest data it has.

query.description: The hostname or IP address looked up.

resolved.description: For a hostname: true when it resolves to an address. For an address: true when it has a hostname.

look_up_routes.description: See the live BGP routes RIPE's route collectors hold for a prefix (a looking glass): each peer's AS path, origin, next hop and communities, collector by collector, plus every origin AS number seen. Near real time. No API key required.
look_up_routes.display_str_template: Look up the BGP routes for {0}.
look_up_routes.name: look_up_routes

parameters.description: A prefix exactly as it is announced (193.0.0.0/21), or an IP address to look up the prefix covering it.
parameters.name: resource

parameters.description: Only show routes confirmed in this many hours. 24 when empty.
parameters.name: max_age_hours

as_of.description: How recent the routing data is (UTC).

collector_count.description: How many route collectors hold a route.

collectors.description: Each route collector and the routes its peers send it.

exchange.description: The Internet exchange it sits at.

as_path.description: The AS path, from the peer to the origin.

as_path_text.description: The AS path as text, e.g. '15692 174 1273 3333'.

communities.description: The BGP communities on the route.

last_confirmed.description: When this route was last confirmed (UTC).

next_hop.description: The next hop the peer uses.

origin_asn.description: The AS number originating the route.

peer_asn.description: The peer's AS number (the first hop of the path).

found.description: True when any collector holds a route.

notes.description: RIPEstat's own notes about the answer, such as an address it widened to its routed prefix or a time it moved to the nearest data it has.

prefixes.description: The prefixes the routes are for.

requested.description: The prefix or address asked about.

route_count.description: How many routes there are in all.

unique_path_count.description: How many different AS paths there are.

search_resources.description: Find AS numbers, prefixes, domains and related resources by a name or part of one, such as a company name or the start of an address. Each result's value can go straight into another RIPEstat step. No API key required.
search_resources.name: search_resources

parameters.description: A name (Cloudflare), a domain (ripe.net), an AS number or the start of an address.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The most results to return in each category.
parameters.name: limit

notes.description: RIPEstat's own notes about the answer, such as an address it widened to its routed prefix or a time it moved to the nearest data it has.

category.description: What kind of result, e.g. 'ASNs', 'Prefixes' or 'Domains'.

description.description: What it is, e.g. the AS number's holder.

value.description: The resource itself, e.g. 'AS13335', ready for another step.

description: Look up any IP address, prefix or AS number with the RIPE NCC's public Internet data: who holds it and their abuse contact, WHOIS records, where it is registered and where it is used, how it is routed and how much of the Internet sees it, its RPKI status, its BGP neighbours and routes, its DNS names and whether it is on a spam blocklist. List a country's address space and networks, or search by name. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
